title: Fable-5 audit batch (6/09-6/11): deployed latent defects in day selection, watchdog sleeps, health alerting, persistence, delivery idempotency and decision inputs
tier_reason: no firing is evidenced, but several links could stop or duplicate delivery, corrupt local state or silence alerts, and unfixed residuals (post_failure's 22:00 ET guard on early-finish EOD runs, the no-games-day bypass of E3/EOD health, the same-day reconcile rollback, the two-file streak+pick atomicity gap, the deferred delivery_unknown state, WARN-only failed DMs not resurfaced) still reach production (B -> A)

contract.text: The deployed service behaves as its code, config and docs state: the scheduler works the ET contest day and feeds the systemd watchdog through every wait; each EOD health check evaluates the processed date, alerts on its documented condition and never goes silent on a crash; a missed delivery is alerted before first pitch (missed_pick_alert_min); pick/streak writes cannot tear and a pick is delivered at most once; live decision inputs match what training/backtest used, shadow features are leak-free, and neither the dashboard nor the deploy path exposes picks or the root key.
contract.source: docs/audit/2026-06-09-fable5-full-audit.md (per-finding contracts); config/orchestrator.example.toml missed_pick_alert_min ('Alert threshold (minutes before first pitch) if no pick posted'); WatchdogSec=1800 (ce5f51d body); src/bts/cli.py _today_et docstring (ET = the contest's timezone); CLAUDE.md Safety Rules (shift(1) temporal guard)

mechanism.text: run_day's EOD run_all_checks call passed no today=, so the day-keyed Tier-1 checks (post_failure, postponed_pick, fallback_defer, analytics_artifacts_missing) evaluated date.today(): an EOD run after midnight checked D+1, found no pick and returned no alert for D

bts schedule without --date took datetime.now(timezone.utc) and the scheduler unit passes no --date, so a scheduler restart between ~20:00 and 24:00 ET (deploy, OOM, watchdog) began run_day for the next date and abandoned that night's result polling, late-slate delivery, DH game 2 and EOD health

the doubleheader game-2 recheck looped a bare time.sleep(dh_recheck_min*60) (15 min default, up to 10x) without watchdog pings, so two sleeps exceeded WatchdogSec=1800 and systemd SIGABRTed the daemon into a crash-restart loop on an unlocked-pick DH day
on a no-games day run_day returned at the 'No games scheduled' guard with no idle sleep, so Restart=always relaunched it every ~30 s all day, spiking NRestarts into a false restart_spike

health contest_state.check measured the lag as calendar days, gap_days = (latest resolved pick - source_date).days (the 58c9adc form), so a multi-day no-pick stretch (off-days, All-Star break) would inflate the gap into a false 'STALE' CRITICAL on the first day back
the health runner's _safe_run caught any check exception, logged it and returned [], so a check that raised every run produced no alert and no DM
predicted_vs_realized.evaluate counted n14 over the whole lookback and never enforced min_days_28d, so early-season drift could go CRITICAL on near-identical overlapping 14d/28d windows
streak_validation.check accepted a corrupt "streak": true as a valid streak (bool subclasses int)

save_pick, save_shadow_pick, save_streak and save_pick_shadow used bare write_text, so a crash or restart mid-write could leave truncated JSON that crashes every loader (check-results, reconcile, scheduler polling, load_decision_streak_state)

retry_urlopen retried the non-idempotent create requests (post, reply, DM send) after a lost response, and _deliver_and_lock_pick sent before persisting any delivery marker, so a committed-but-unacknowledged send or a crash between send and record could deliver the pick twice

missed_pick_alert_min was read into a local in run_day and never used, so no in-window missed-pick alert existed; the only delivery-failure signal was the EOD post_failure DM, hours after the window closed
dispatch_dm_for_health_alerts recorded status 'failed' after its in-call attempts and nothing resurfaced it, so a day-keyed one-shot CRITICAL was lost when that EOD's DM failed

realized_calibration's since-deploy filter compared ISO strings with different UTC offsets lexicographically, took git commit time (%cI) as deploy time and moved backward after a canary rollback, so the calibration pool admitted or dropped the wrong picks

load_decision_streak_state mapped contest.saver_available=None (the profile API cannot observe the saver) to False on the normal fresh-contest path, so the MDP decision never saw an available saver at streak 10-15
load_contest_streak_state parsed both contest files before the precedence check, so a corrupt auto file raised and blocked a valid unexpired manual override (fail-closed: no decision state, no pick)

reconcile_results recomputed the streak with a backward walk that stopped at the first miss without replaying the 10-15 saver, so the nightly reconcile under-counted a saver-preserved streak in streak.json
the blend averaged each model's game probability per batter_id, so a batter in both games of a doubleheader got one probability mixing both matchups, mapped back to both rows
_fetch_prior_lineup hardcoded startDate=2026-03-20&endDate=2026-12-31, so from 2027 the projected-lineup fallback would return 2026 lineups (no effect inside the 2026 season)

compute_all_features rolled the shadow CONTEXT column batter_hard_contact_30g over PA rows (window 120) with one shift(1) across the batter-sorted series, so each batter's first row inherited the previous batter's value and the window kept same-date PAs: leakage in the context-stack shadow model and its promotion eval
the dashboard's main() bound 0.0.0.0:3003 with no app-layer auth, so only an out-of-band firewall kept pre-publication picks and the /api/audit-progress SSH fan-out off the public internet

/api/audit-progress accepted unsanitized dir and seeds_file (a directory-existence oracle; a found boxes.json triggered root-SSH fan-out with the prod key), and deploy.yml ran the floating appleboy/ssh-action@v1 tag while holding the root SSH key

the leaderboard scraper parsed responses outside its try, so one schema-drift error aborted the whole scrape; public usernames were used unsanitized as parquet filenames (path-traversal write); the outbound User-Agent carried a real email in the public repo

mitigated.action: an external network firewall blocked :3003 from the public IPv4 (the audit's external probe timed out)

residual.text: post_failure's 22:00 ET time guard still returns no alert while the processed date is the current ET date, so the single EOD run of an early-finishing day never raises it; passing today= (88234ae) closed only the post-midnight half. The in-window E3 alert (bb7ccc1, corrected by 224ddce) is the compensating control.
residual.source: fable5 memo 'Day-keyed Tier-1 checks no-op on post-midnight / early-finish nights'; src/bts/health/post_failure.py check (EARLIEST_HOUR_ET = 22, unchanged at 9907cb9) -- my reading

residual.text: The no-games-day early return still bypasses step 5b (E3) and EOD health, and there is no independent cron-side day-outcome watchdog.
residual.source: docs/optimization-ideas.md 'Independent day-outcome watchdog' (I-206); ec242da body ('no-games days never run health')

calibration, projected_lineup, post_failure and disk_fill swallowed their own exceptions and returned [], defeating the _safe_run CRITICAL (link 7) until a349ac5 (7/09, I-073 F4).

residual.text: bb7ccc1 gated the E3 alert on not state.pick_locked; a non-delivered classification lock set it and the alert stayed silent on 8/13 (I-083), fixed by 224ddce.
The deploy-time stamp adopted in d94a51f reset the realized_calibration sample on every deploy, so the check was effectively dead until the regime-fingerprint pool (40c0094, 7/09, I-073 F6).
The model-saver proxy introduced by 0794116 was judged unsound and retired 6/17-6/18 (810d7e0 ledger/best_streak inference, then 815cf50 saver_state.json as sole authority; I-111).

Reconcile's replay (like the backward walk it replaced) skips today's pick file, so a daytime, 23:00 or cross-midnight manual reconcile rolls back today's already-applied increment and can restore a consumed saver; deferred.
residual.source: docs/audit/2026-09-28-reconcile-cutoff-codex-r1.md #3 ('Pre-existing defect'); r2 ('#3 remains deferred'); design section 10.2 (I-202)

residual.text: Atomic single-file writes do not make the two-file streak+pick update atomic; a crash between update_streak and the pick save can double-apply a day (audit P3); the atomicity journal was deferred.
residual.source: fable5 memo 'Strategy & contest-decision path' [P3]; 49f2538 body ('Deferred: two-file streak+pick atomicity journal'); I-204

residual.text: An uncaught crash between send and record leaves delivery_attempted set and locks the day unconfirmed without re-send (manual verification); the non-scoreable delivery_unknown terminal state was deferred.
A failed health DM is resurfaced only when it carried CRITICALs (WARN-only failures are not), and only on the next dispatch.
The experiment copy BatterHardnessExperiment.modify_features still rolls PA rows (window 120) with a whole-series shift(1); whether any deployed research stream runs it is unknown.
residual.source: src/bts/experiment/features.py at c27480e and 9907cb9 -- my reading

residual.text: The dashboard still has no app-layer auth; exposure depends on the tailnet bind (overridable via BTS_DASHBOARD_HOST) plus the external firewall.

watchdog.trigger: at the earliest pick game's first pitch minus 5 minutes of the ET contest day, a candidate pick exists on disk with no delivery record, no scoreable commit and no recorded deliberate skip (covers the evening-restart abandonment, link 3; crash loops, links 4 and 10; the blocked override, link 16; the missing in-window alert, link 12); companion restart check (V5): >= 3 unplanned scheduler restarts within 60 minutes (links 4, 5)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: an alert is delivered (retried on failure), the ET date ends with a scoreable commit or an explicit operator pass, and the EOD health run for the processed date completes with any crashed check surfaced as CRITICAL
